title: TDOA Estimator
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Direction of Arrival/TDOA_Estimator.md
text: 估计到达时间差，输入 3 路、输出 4 路；{Inherit sample rate} 指定从上游模块继承采样率、{Signal sample rate (Hz)} 指定信号采样率、{Maximum number of TDOA estimates} 指定 TDOA 估计值的最大数量、{Enable known delay offset input} 启用已知延迟偏移输入、{Output variance of TDOA Estimates} 输出 TDOA 估计值的方差、{Output TDOA response and TDOA grid} 输出 TDOA 响应和 TDOA 网格、{Source of noise power} 指定噪声功率源、{Noise power (W)} 指定噪声功率、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: X
ports.summary: 输入数据 N -by- M -by- L complex-valued array

ports.name: DelayOffset
ports.summary: 延迟偏移（秒） scalar | 1-by- L real-valued vector

ports.name: Npow
ports.summary: 输入噪声功率 (W) positive scalar | 1-by- L vector of positive values

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: TDOA 估计值（秒） K -by-( L -1) real-valued matrix

ports.name: Var
ports.summary: 估计的 TDOA 方差 1-by-( L -1) positive-value vector

ports.name: TDOAResp
ports.summary: TDOA 响应 P -by- M -by-( L -1) MATLAB ® array

ports.name: TDOAGrid
ports.summary: TDOA 网格 real-valued P -by-( L -1) matrix

params.name: Inherit sample rate
params.values: 从上游模块继承采样率 on (default) | off

params.name: Signal sample rate (Hz)
params.values: 信号采样率 1000000 (default) | real-valued positive scalar

params.name: Maximum number of TDOA estimates
params.values: TDOA 估计值的最大数量 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Enable known delay offset input
params.values: 启用已知延迟偏移输入 false (0) (default) | true (1)

params.name: Output variance of TDOA Estimates
params.values: 输出 TDOA 估计值的方差 false (0) (default) | true (1)

params.name: Output TDOA response and TDOA grid
params.values: 输出 TDOA 响应和 TDOA 网格 false (0) (default) | true (1)

params.name: Source of noise power
params.values: 噪声功率源 Property (default) | Input port

params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
